# Notice and licensing

This project is a source translation of the numerical algorithms in
`GPArotation` 2026.8-2.

Upstream authors:

- Coen Bernaards
- Paul Gilbert
- Robert Jennrich

The upstream package declares `License: GPL (>= 2)`. This translation is
therefore distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later. `LICENSE` contains the GNU GPL v2
text; the "or later" permission follows the upstream declaration.

The original `DESCRIPTION`, `NAMESPACE`, R source files, and upstream test files
used during translation are retained under `orig/` for provenance. They remain
subject to the upstream copyright and licensing terms.

Primary algorithm reference:

Bernaards, C. A. and Jennrich, R. I. (2005), Gradient projection algorithms and
software for arbitrary rotation criteria in factor analysis, Educational and
Psychological Measurement 65, 676-696.
